entities.name: Arabella
entities.description: A quickened porcelain toy from Duskmourn who hates survivors and commands packs of damaged toys.

entities.name: Boilerbilges
entities.description: Part of the House where damaged toys and dolls gather; contains a furnace.

entities.name: The House
entities.description: The house of Duskmourn whose hallways Arabella's packs roam.

events.summary: Arabella quickens with affection for her owner, but the owner tries to destroy her by shattering her and dropping her into a Boilerbilges furnace.
events.quote: Her owner, however, reacted out of fear and tried to destroy her by shattering her body and dropping her into a Boilerbilges furnace.

events.summary: Arabella finds the Boilerbilges teeming with other damaged toys and takes command of them.
events.quote: Under Arabella's command, they now roam the House's hallways in hunting packs

relations.note: Commands the damaged toys of the Boilerbilges (target is the place)
